pages.text: Frequently asked questions about Treasury bills, published by the SYN Central Bank. Question: What is the minimum bid for a Treasury bill? Answer: SYN Sh 40,000. Question: What maturities do Treasury bills come in? Answer: 91, 182 and 364 days. Question: Can Treasury bills be sold before maturity? Answer: Yes, on the secondary market. These answers are updated whenever the rules change. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
